notes:
LTTH Version 1.4.1 Release Notes

LTTH 1.4.1 now ships Stream Monsters 1.8.0 as an Open Beta while keeping every other plugin version unchanged, including WebGPU Fireworks 3.1.1.

- NEW: Optional recurring free eggs reserve for 60 seconds after first chat contact, then enter a transactional public FIFO for !adopt; the default cooldown is 24 hours
- NEW: 72 bundled Furry forms cover 24 monster templates across Evolution I, II, and III with verified local assets and a Kenney emergency fallback
- NEW: Rules-v6 PvP keeps A/B/C decisions sealed until simultaneous reveal, with 10-second roster, 6-second skill, and 15-second stat windows
- NEW: Six balanced element families and Striker, Guardian, Trickster, and Sustain roles retain complete deterministic replay data
- NEW: Separate Collector Score and Arena Rating leaderboards run in configurable seasons while collections, evolution, levels, and stats remain permanent
- NEW: Portrait-first and landscape OBS arenas use one deterministic timeline, WebGPU effects with Canvas2D fallback, five audio channels, and curated CC0 cues
- CHANGED: Only the first 10 legitimate daily battles alter rating and seasonal rewards, while every legitimate completion grants monster XP
- CHANGED: Overlay-only tutorial hints use active GCCE prefixes and aliases without posting automatic chat messages
- CHANGED: The six-area Creator Live Center replaces Art Lab; no provider, model installer, generation pool, or image-generation runtime ships in Stream Monsters 1.8.0
- FIXED: Durable adoption, queue/forfeit boundaries, battle reload recovery, sanitized replay projection, bounded overlay queues, renderer fallback, and structured privacy-safe diagnostics harden live operation
- COMPATIBILITY: The stable streamalchemy plugin ID, existing player data, legacy battle replays, and every published Stream Monsters archive through 1.5.0 are preserved
